en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 1.27 per cent lower at 24,481
en.dek: The benchmark fell 315 points on Friday amid a regional tech sell-off, though it still recorded a 5.1 per cent weekly gain.
body: Hong Kong stocks closed lower on Friday as a tech-led sell-off that began on Wall Street spread across Asian markets. The Hang Seng Index ended down 315 points, or 1.27 per cent, at 24,481.86.
The Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 1.83 per cent to 4,078, while the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index fell 1.13 per cent to 8,274. Turnover on the main board was about HK$247 billion.
Despite the daily decline, the Hang Seng Index still posted a 5.1 per cent gain for the week, its strongest weekly advance since March 2025. The tech gauge rose 8.6 per cent over the five sessions.

Mainland indices also weakened, with the Shanghai Composite ending 1.1 per cent lower and the Shenzhen Component down 2.57 per cent. Analysts attributed the pressure to concerns that a Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections could bring tighter scrutiny of the artificial-intelligence sector.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌1.27% 報 24481點
zh.dek: 受區內科技股拖累影響，恒指周五跌315點，但全周仍累升5.1%。
body: 受美股科技股回調影響，港股周五收市下跌。恒生指數最終下跌315點，或百分之1.27，收報24481.86點。
恒生科技指數跌1.83%至4078點，國企指數跌1.13%至8274點。主板成交額約為2474億港元。
雖然單日下跌，恒指全周仍累升5.1%，為2025年3月以來最佳週表現。科技指數周內升8.6%。
內地指數同步走低，上證綜指跌1.1%，深證成指跌2.57%。分析指美國中期選舉民主黨大勝可能加強對人工智能板塊監管，影響投資者情緒。
